headline: Fort Ember Falls As Major Fronts Go Quiet
war_summary: Since the last edition the wire brings a fresh stir from Fisherman's Row, where Fort Ember changed hands twice in two hours with a Warden capture logged at 20:33, leaving the region at eight Colonial to one Warden. Linn Mercy, lately the hottest sector, has eased to a single change in two hours, last at 19:15, though the day still counts twenty affairs about Rotdust and Lathair with the holdings at ten Colonial to one Warden amid 4,342 Colonial and 6,891 Warden casualties. The Weathered Expanse has fallen silent the past two hours since 18:10, holding six Warden to three Colonial after fourteen day affairs about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch with 11,780 Colonial and 12,703 Warden losses. Stonecradle counts seventeen day affairs but none in two hours, Stlican Shelf four and Oarbreaker three, all quiet of late, while Dead Lands and Mooring County show no fresh moves. Guns remain loud without ground changing at Nevish Line and Marban Hollow, the latter counting 606 Colonial and 653 Warden losses in two hours with rates still quickening.
